name: example-remotion-only
description: Pure Remotion: server-side rendering of a composition, single or chunked, locally and on Cloudflare Containers.

scripts.site: npm run assets && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs sites create src/index.ts --site-name=site
scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.local: npm run site && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs render Shapes --local --out=out/local.mp4
scripts.docker:build: npm run site && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile -t rrh-remotion-only ../..
scripts.deploy: npm run site && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs services deploy
